description: Only for when the person explicitly asks for a custom, from-scratch, AI-designed WeInc website. It does NOT make a site: it returns a link, and the AI build starts only after the person confirms in their browser. For any other request for a WeInc website ("make me a website for my bakery"), use create_website_from_template instead: it makes the finished site immediately. Put everything you know into `brief`: business name, what they do, location, services, audience, tone, pages wanted, contact details. Optionally pass `template_id` from find_templates. The build starts only after the person confirms on that page.

brief.description: Full description of the business and the website wanted.

name: start_website
title: Start a new website
